metric: bytes of `docker export` of a container created from the image (the flattened filesystem, uncompressed; the same on every image store)
notes: engine: the reference engine image (debian:bookworm-slim plus tl-serve). gateway: the reference gateway image on alpine:3.19 (14055424 bytes with the tracer binary of 6029496 bytes) with that binary replaced by one linking every gateway package (config, auth, server, proxy, ledger with the pure-Go SQLite driver, gRPC, OpenTelemetry: 14932770 bytes). A budget of twice the reference catches a toolchain or a build cache shipped in the runtime stage, not a few megabytes of features.
